title: Promote to stable
summary: The confirmation behind 'Promote 1.8.1 to stable' on Diceroll's Release tracks, after the 1.8.0 demote: what goes live on each channel (Polaris Key at once, a staged Google Play rollout prefilled to 20%, itch.io, the App Store after review, Steam skipped because it isn't connected) and a typed confirmation of the version.
compare: Opens over Release tracks in the state of packages.release-tracks (stable on 1.7.3, itch.io's failed switch-back in stable's lane); Release accent (cyan).
The title is a question naming the release and the track; the first sentence says 1.8.1 joins stable, stays on beta, and every license gets it.

'What changes' has one row per channel with an outcome at the right: Polaris Key 'At once' (update checks, the download page and Library); Google Play 'Staged' with the percentage as a field prefilled from the last rollout; itch.io 'Goes live' (replacing the 1.8.0 build left on windows-x64); App Store 'After review' with 'Submit 1.8.1 for App Store review' checked; Steam 'Skipped' (no Steamworks publisher key yet), with Connect Steam.

Going live on stores is one typed click: 'Type 1.8.1 to promote it to stable' with the kit's neutral confirm word (nothing is lost), then the primary 'Promote 1.8.1 to stable' with an up arrow. Cancel is the kit's outline button.

If a channel fails, the result is the same partial-success form as the demote on packages.release-tracks: a warning toast 'Promoted 1.8.1, except on <channel>' with Retry and a callout in stable's lane.
Phone: the kit's bottom sheet; the body scrolls, each row's outcome drops under its text, and the buttons are pinned full width with the primary on top.

designReview.reviewer: 4 UX designers, triaged by a lead designer
designReview.verdict: Spacing and copy trimmed per the multi-review triage; see findings.

findings.issue: Row descriptions repeat the lane page.
findings.resolution: Each row cut to one clause; the facts that change the action stay (percentage input, App Store submit checkbox, Steam Not connected with Connect); phone sheet scrolls under a fade at 90vh; Cancel is a text button on phone.
